title: Synthetic Factory Actor Provenance v1
description: Record-level actor envelope for multi-stage synthetic software-engineering workflows (#154). Factory trust remains config/FACTORY-REGISTRY.json (issue #32): this schema does not grant authority and does not hard-code generator slugs. A new model occupies an existing role by filling these fields. source_kind distinguishes synthetic factory work from real_public_engineering (including Operation Prometheus). Oracle status is independent of solver success. identity.unresolved_provenance is the identity-lane gap for missing state.sim_or_real / state.provenance (designed|simulated|hil|unknown in schemas/provenance.md); it must never be reused for a missing task_author, solver, reviewer, or oracle — those stay vset.* codes.

canonicalRepo.description: Canonical lowercase GitHub owner/name: owner of 1-39 alphanumerics or single hyphens with no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphen; name of 1-100 alphanumerics, '.', '_' or '-', never '.' or '..'. The pattern is pipelines/repo_identity.py CANONICAL_REPO_PATTERN verbatim, and the release-manifest, exclusion-list, and alias-cache schemas $ref this definition.

source_kind.description: Synthetic factory records must never masquerade as Prometheus real trajectories.

allOf.description: Author of the task specification. Distinct from solver.
Execution agent. A solver success must not upgrade oracle.status.

reviewer.description: Optional when no review stage exists; required and explicit for review_remediation_v1.

kind.description: How the oracle is realized. solver_self_report and task_author_claim cannot certify validated.

certifier.description: Must not be the solver or task_author identity when status is validated.

decision.description: accept is the positive training admission. invalid/impossible tasks use measure, not a silent drop.

source_repo.description: Public source repository as canonical lowercase GitHub owner/name (#494). Required when source_kind is real_public_engineering; the compose eval-exclusion gate resolves it through config/eval-exclusion/repo-aliases.json and matches it whole against the eval denylist and do-not-train list.

factory_contract_version.description: Must match config/FACTORY-REGISTRY.json schema_version (factory-registry-v0.3). Authority stays in that reviewed table.
